meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (jurisdiction ID FR, unitary national jurisdiction; no materially separate sub-state corporate register)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law, derived from the 1804 Civil Code and the Commercial Code, with EU law enjoying direct effect and primacy.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-United States income tax treaty and protocols of 1967 and 2009
France-Germany double taxation agreement (applicable within EU/EEA context)
France-China double taxation agreement of 26 November 2013, in force 1 January 2015, as amended by the OECD Multilateral Instrument
France-Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement, in force since 1997
France-Singapore Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, signed 8 December 2007, in force 2010
EU fundamental freedoms and EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment signed 30 December 2020, pending ratification

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 through L.561-57 and R.561-1 through R.561-58 of the Code monétaire et financier as amended by Sapin II Law no. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 and Decree no. 2016-1600 of 25 November 2016, transposing EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843. The beneficial-owner register (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) is governed by Articles L.561-45 to L.561-49 and R.561-10 to R.561-12 CMF and is filed with the RCS at the moment of company registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statuts constitutifs de la SARL (Articles of Association) signed by the founding members, including the paid-in capital and UBO clauses
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders and corporate-law counsel; notarial form not mandatory for non-real-estate contributions
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent Cour d'appel or the relevant Préfecture, or consular legalization if the origin country is not party to the 1961 Hague Convention; followed by certified French translation by a sworn court interpreter

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extrait Kbis (Certificate of Incorporation) issued after RCS registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Greffe du tribunal de commerce of the registered-office district, via the INPI/RNCS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent Cour d'appel for use abroad; no notarization required for domestic use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif (UBO declaration) attached to the registration file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: INPI acting as operator of the Registre National des Entreprises and the RCS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required for domestic recognition; foreign-endorsed copies shall be apostilled only if subsequently used outside France

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity and good-standing documents of each foreign shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner (passport, bank references, address proof, corporate registry extract if the shareholder is a company)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry, notary or public authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization at the French Embassy or Consulate of the issuing state, plus certified French translation by a translator approved by the Cour d'appel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered-office domiciliation agreement or lease with a CCI-approved domiciliation company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Société de domiciliation agréée by the regional Chamber of Commerce and Industry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization generally not required; apostille only if the agreement must be produced before a foreign regulator

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of French domestic PEPs, EU and international PEPs and family members, against OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated Lists, EU Consolidated Sanctions Files (ARIS/SURE) and national asset-freeze measures under Article L.562-1 CMF. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for any PEP or politically exposed beneficial owner, in line with Article L.561-10 CMF. Wire-transfer and escrow payments are screened under the travel rule of Regulation (EU) 2023/1113. Suspicious transactions must be reported to Tracfin under Article L.561-15 CMF with no tipping-off; source-of-funds documentation must be obtained for each client before engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); pre-availability searchable through data.inpi.fr and the Registre National des Entreprises; final RCS acts are deposited via the same portal and Kbis extracts are obtained from the relevant Greffe du tribunal de commerce through Infogreffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French is the mandatory working language for RCS filings, statutory announcements and consumer-facing documents under the Toubon Law of 4 August 1994. Company names may contain diacritical marks and are registered in the Latin script as declared. Any transliteration of a foreign trade name must be reproduced exactly in the Articles of Association and must not create likelihood of confusion with an existing registered name or trademark in France.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection of a requested corporate name by the INPI/RCS, the applicant may first file a reconsideration request via the Guichet unique within fifteen (15) working days from notification. If reconsideration is refused, a formal appeal may be lodged with the judge supervising the register (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) of the competent Commercial Court, in accordance with Articles R.123-3 to R.123-6 Code de commerce, generally within thirty (30) days. Where the name conflict is based on a prior trademark or trade name, opposition proceedings must be brought in the competent commercial court. For prohibited tokens, a special ministerial or ACPR authorization must be obtained before re-filing; failing that, the applicant should re-submit a second-choice name with a fully re-issued registration file.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A SARL may lawfully be domiciled at a service address provided by a CCI-approved domiciliation company under Articles L.123-11-1 et seq. Code de commerce. However, for an ISIC 7810 study-abroad and immigration-visa advisory business, the French licensing authority and Tracfin will in practice expect a physical office with client meeting capacity, secure filing systems and demonstrable management oversight. A pure virtual mailbox without workspace would fail the commercial-substance test for the préfectoral operating licence and would elevate AML risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 30% quantified likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection during the first operating year, primarily by DGCCRF consumer-protection officers, the Préfecture immigration unit, or Tracfin inspectors acting under Article L.561-39 CMF. Given the medium-risk AML tier of immigration-visa consulting, a physical on-site visit is reasonably probable and the registered office must be operational, labelled and staffed during business hours.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark flat fee, EUR 200-350 per hour or capped engagement at EUR 1,500-3,500

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the constitution notice in a Journal d'annonces légales approved for the registered office's department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff range EUR 130-220 per announcement, plus VAT

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic incorporation filing through the Guichet unique and registration in the RNCS/RCS operated by INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee for a new SARL registration (approximately EUR 54, paid online)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Greffe legal fees of the Commercial Court and initial issuance of the Extrait Kbis certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce of the registered-office district
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff set by decree, approximate EUR 170-230 depending on the court

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration (Déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif) attached to the RCS registration file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI/RCS as part of the registration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No separate statutory fee; included in the incorporation filing tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translations by a court-approved translator of foreign passports, corporate constitutional documents, UBO chain documentation, apostilled certificates and bank references
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent sworn translator (traducteur agréé près la Cour d'appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of EUR 60-120 per page depending on language and urgency

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostilles and/or consular legalization of foreign public documents for each shareholder and beneficial owner, including subclass fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Préfecture/Cour d'appel for foreign-use documents; French Embassy or Consulate for consular legalization of non-Hague documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular and statutory fee mosaic, average EUR 8-25 per document plus courier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation regulatory clearance advisory for the study-abroad and immigration-visa operating licence, including preparation of the préfectoral authorization dossier and licencing conditions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee for pre-incorporation licensing support, EUR 700-1,500 project fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office for year one at a CCI-approved domiciliation company with physical reception room, meeting room and secure mail handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Société de domiciliation agréée (Chamber of Commerce certified business centre)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of EUR 40-65 per month excluding file fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a limited-scope GDPR compliance package, EUR 200-400

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III: Articles L223-1 to L223-43 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée formation, share capital, and management); Articles L210-1 to L210-10 (general company law); Civil Code Articles 1832-1844-17 (contract of partnership).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office's court jurisdiction, filing submitted electronically through the Guichet Unique Electronique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr using the Infogreffe network.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société en commandite? Not applicable. In this case: Statuts de la SARL and Déclaration de constitution de société (Form M0), transmitted via the Guichet Unique Electronique to the Commercial Registry (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legally fixed minimum share capital for a SARL. The articles must state a capital amount; cash contributions must be subscribed and at least 20% of any cash share capital must be paid up before registration. The paid-up portion must be deposited into a blocked escrow account held with a French bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, financial institution, or notary; the balance is payable within five years of incorporation. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up upon transfer.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a meeting held in Paris on [date], the sole founder and shareholder of [Company], a French Société à Responsabilité Limitée, having reviewed the draft statutes and the certificate of capital subscription, unanimously passed the following resolutions: (1) the company is formally constituted under the name [Company] with registered office at [address]; (2) the entire share capital of EUR [amount] divided into [number] equal shares is subscribed and accepted by the undersigned, and the required initial deposit has been paid into a blocked escrow account; (3) the registered office is fixed for ten years at the stated address; (4) [Name] is appointed as sole manager for the full term of the company; and (5) the manager is authorized to execute statutory filings, open bank accounts, and complete all post-registration formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Validation of Company Name and Corporate Purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) for trademark conflict; Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for name availability review; Guichet Unique for preliminary electronic validation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a trademark search on the INPI database and a name availability check on the Commercial Registry. Verify that the proposed corporate name and principal activity (international student placement and immigration visa advisory services) are not contrary to public order or reserved to regulated professions. Prepare an initial memorandum confirming the permissible activity wording for the articles.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (dénomination sociale)
Project business plan and description of international student placement and visa advisory services
Identity document of the sole founder or shareholder
Draft corporate purpose clause addressed to the registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or purpose is rejected due to conflict, prohibited activity, or inadequate drafting, amend the statute clause and resubmit via the Guichet Unique Electronique; in the case of trademark opposition, await any five-month opposition period and select a secondary name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French notary (when in-kind contributions or special advantages are present) or the shareholder/legal counsel under ordinary private-signature rules, with electronic signature through an EU-qualified service provider.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the French-language statutes containing the company name, corporate object, registered office, capital amount, class of shares, transfer restrictions, manager powers, and audit arrangements. Execute the statutes before a notary in a formal protocol, or by private instrument electronically signed and dated. Notarization is mandatory where the SARL receives any contribution-in-kind of real property or a regulated business asset.
required_dossiers: Draft statutes dated and signed
Copy of the founder's passport or national ID
Proof of registered office address (lease, title deed, domiciliation agreement)
Certified translation of the founder's identity documents, if not in French
Statement of the subscribed share capital and the manner of payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the electronic signature platform raises a documentation deficiency, correct the missing exhibits, re-execute the affected page, and obtain a fresh signature certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening and Funding the Blocked Capital Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed French bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary's escrow account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a professional account in the name of the company-in-formation with a French bank or deposit the cash share capital into a notary's blocked account. Transfer at least 20% of the cash capital subscribed. Obtain from the bank or notary a certificate of deposit (
step_by_step_formation_sop.) evidencing the blocked amount and the: Open a professional account in the name of the company-in-formation with a French bank or deposit the cash share capital into a notary's blocked account. Transfer at least 20% of the cash share capital subscribed. Obtain a certificate of deposit from the bank or notary showing the funds are blocked and cannot be withdrawn without the registry receipt. The certificate must be dated within not more than 15 days before the M0 filing. Deliver a copy of the certificate to the Guichet Unique portal. The escrow institution shall release the funds after the Kbis certificate is obtained.
required_dossiers: Bank or notary certificate of blocked deposit (attestation de blocage de fonds)
Payment receipt for the transferred funds, showing the contributing shareholder and the company name
Identity documents and bank signature card of the company representative
Source of funds declaration and any supporting loan or gift documents (if applicable)
Draft statutes containing the share capital subscription clause
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional AML/KYC documentation or refuses a foreign source of funds, provide a certified source-of-wealth declaration, correct the payment instructions, or substitute a French notarial escrow account holding the funds. Obtain a new certificate of deposit before proceeding to the filing step.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Incorporation Dossier via the Guichet Unique Electronique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique Electronique operated by the Institut National des Formations, submitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and electronically sign the M0 declaration through the official portal, attach all statutory documents and the certificate of deposit, and pay the applicable registry fees by electronic payment. The system routes the file to the Commercial Registry clerk and begins the four-day legal control period. After acceptance, the registry clerk will issue the receipt of deposit and proceed to publication of the legal notice in the Bulletin d'Annonces Légales Obligatoires (BALO). The company must also obtain an official address for the delivery of the Kbis certificate and the French SIREN/SIRET identifiers.
required_dossiers: M0 declaration form completed and signed
Signed statutes (one original or a certified copy)
Certificate of deposit of the paid-up portion of the share capital
Domiciliation contract or lease for the registered office
Photographic ID and passport of all managers/shareholders
Declaration of beneficial ownership (bénéficiaire effectif) if a natural or legal person holds more than 25% of capital or control
Power of attorney if a representative signs the application
Notice of legal appointment of the manager with consent to serve
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry declares the application incomplete or defective, the legal opposition period allows the applicant to correct the deficiencies through the Guichet Unique within 15 days of notification. The original filing deadline restarts only after the defect is cured; if the defect is not corrected within the appointed period, the file is cancelled and a new filing must be made.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Issuance of the Kbis Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the company's court district.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the statutory control expires without opposition or after a successful cure, the registry clerk enters the company in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, assigns the SIREN/SIRET numbers, and issues a Kbis extract. The Kbis is the official certificate of legal existence and turnover. The registry also emits the corporate identification numbers to the National Institute for Statistics and Economic Studies and transmits the file to the tax and social authorities. The final filing publication in the BALO is validated by the registry. Upon receipt of the Kbis, the bank is or notary is required to release the blocked funds to the company's operating bank account.
required_dossiers: Copy of the valid M0 filing receipt
Proof of publication of the legal notice in the BALO
Certificate of deposit of the share capital with the registry stamp
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry rejects the Kbis because of a procedural defect or a third-party opposition, the company may file a summary request with the presiding judge of the Commercial Court; the corrected file is then re-submitted within the re-opened delay, and the Kbis is reissued free of charge upon favorable court order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) and the social security authority URSSAF; the company may also be subject to the local Chamber of Commerce rather than industrial licensing because the activity is service-based.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the Kbis and SIRET number to register at the competent tax office, open the permanent corporate tax file, and receive the CED (company identification code). Register the employer file with URSSAF for payroll as soon as the first employee or manager wage is paid. Subscribe to the appropriate social security and health insurance schemes for the manager and staff, and complete the declaration of establishment. If the activity involves physical contact with clients in France, a business premises declaration must be made to the municipality or to the Direccte/DDETS, but no industrial or environmental operating permit is required because the activity is classified as office-based services.
required_dossiers: Kbis certificate
SIRET number
German? Correction: French bank account details
Copy of the manager's passport and residency evidence
Any professional insurance policy (RGPD for data processing, professional liability) if contracted
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax or social registration is not automatically generated because the registry transmission is incomplete, present the Kbis and SIRET at the local DDFiP center or contact URSSAF hotline; any duplicate or erroneous registration may be corrected through the 'Création de compte' portal or by letter to the tax inspector.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Declaration of Activity for the Study-Abroad and Immigration Visa Advisory Sector
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Départementale de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DDETS) for any regulated employment or immigration permit activity; otherwise the local Préfecture for a simple business presence declaration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the scope includes immigration visa residence advisory, the company must confirm whether its activity falls under the regulated category of 'assistance to foreigners for entry, stay, and work' under the CESEDA (Code de l'entrée et du séjour des étrangers et du droit d'asile). If the activity is limited to non-regulated information and document preparation, no special license is required. If an activity is considered a regulated immigration consultancy, the company must not perform any activity reserved to authorized law or admin assistance professionals without prior written authorization from the Prefect. In either case, the company must file a business premises declaration (déclaration d'existence) with the competent municipal authority and verify that the registered office is statistically controlled for the declared activity.
required_dossiers: Kbis certificate
Letter of activity description signed by the manager
Copy of the lease or official domiciliation certificate
Passport copy of the manager and compliance certification (e.g. completion of an anti-fraud and AML training course)
Contract templates for client agreements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Préfecture or DDETS informs the company that the activity is subject to a specific authorization, the company must immediately refrain from carrying out the regulated activity until the permit is obtained, then file a licence application with complete documents with 60 days; if the declaration is rejected due to incomplete information, re-file with additional support within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Although the target ISIC activity is a service-sector study-abroad and immigration visa consultancy, no industrial manufacturing license is required. The relevant administrative authority is the Direction Départementale de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DDETS) for labour compliance and the local municipality for business-premises and fire-safety clearance. If the company operates a physical office open to the public, an 'autorisation d'exploitation' or 'permis de construire' may be required by the planning authority. Therefore, the competent industrial authority is defined as Direction Départementale des Territoires (DDT) for structural safety and Directorate of Labour for occupational compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No official industrial licence title applies to an international student placement and immigration visa advisory office. The company holds a Kbis extract as its general operating licence. Where a physical client-reception office is opened, the operating authorization is the 'Certificat d'Occupation' or 'Permis de Construire' issued by the local town hall, together with the registration of the premises for fire-safety and accessibility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique, through the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the local water authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt. The activity is classified as a non-industrial service operation (CERP category 'N/A – service activity without installations classified under ICPE'). No environmental impact assessment is required for the operation of an administrative office. A simplified short environmental notice may be required if the company installs waste bins, air-conditioning units above a threshold of 2 kW, or performs building works.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharges are generated. Office wastewater is discharged to the municipal sewer network, subject to local sewerage bylaws requiring no additional pre-treatment for domestic-type sanitation. Volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions are limited to cleaning products and printed materials and must respect the general exposure threshold of 1 mg/m³ in the public workplace under French Labour Code Articles R4412-1 to R4412-34. Waste handling must comply with the Regional Waste Prevention Plan; all paper, cardboard, plastic, and hazardous waste (ink cartridges, electronic equipment) must be segregated and deposited with an approved waste collector. If waste is generated in quantities greater than 1,100 kg per month, the company must report to ADEME via ADRS and maintain a waste registration sheet. If the office uses a server or ICT equipment, any cooling gases must be contained and monitored under Regulation (EU) 517/2014.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification: For an office with a public reception area up to 100 persons and ground-floor exits, a simplified fire technical notice must be submitted to the municipal fire commission; a full 'avis de sécurité' from the police or fire brigade is required if the public capacity exceeds 50 persons in the reception rooms. Structural load inspections: verify the floor loading capacity does not exceed 500 kg/m² and that any suspended ceilings and lighting are certified for the prescribed live load. Occupational clearance: the company must obtain a health and medical aptitude certificate from the occupational physician for each employee, provide workplace first-aid equipment, and submit the company's 'document unique d'évaluation des risques' to the CSE (Social and Economic Committee) where applicable. A worker-safety inspection by the DGT may be conducted for any establishment where workers carry or use display screens and handle passports/visa documents.

stage_2.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification, structural load inspections, and workplace clearance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique; main portals: impots.gouv.fr (declaration and payment of TVA/IS), formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises for TIN issuance), and the DGDDI (Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects) for customs/export clearance. Intra-community VAT validation via the EU VIES system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the SARL by filing the M0 creation file through the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); INSEE automatically allocates the SIREN (9-digit national tax/statistical identifier) and SIRET (14-digit establishment number), and the DGFiP issues the n° TVA intracommunautaire (format FR + 2-digit key + SIREN) within 7–15 working days. Step 2: Open a corporate bank account in France and file the statement of existence (liasse fiscale 2065-SD) at the competent SIE (Service des Impôts des Entreprises); electronic filing via EDI–TDFC/EFI is compulsory. Step 3 (foreign non-established supplier variant): a supplier not established in France must file a direct VAT registration application with the DGFiP (Cerfa n° 16161*01) at the non-resident taxpayer office (SIE non-résidents, Noisy-le-Grand) before the first taxable transaction; EU-established suppliers register directly, whereas non-EU suppliers must appoint an accredited fiscal representative with a bank guarantee (Art. 164 quinquies A CGI). Step 4: obtain an AEO/status certificates if customs export flows are contemplated; no separate national tax ID is otherwise required for an SARL.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — an SARL is by default a separate taxable person subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS; standard rate 25% for 2025) on its worldwide results (Art. 206-1 and 209-I CGI); there is no unlimited territorial scope for an SARL resident in France. Pass_Through_Eligible — a qualifying commercial SARL whose members are all natural persons may irrevocably opt for income-tax transparency (imposition à l'impôt sur le revenu des associés) for a 5-fiscal-year period under Art. 239 bis AA CGI; no 'check-the-box' mechanism exists in French law. Tax_Exempt_Zone — not applicable for metropolitan France; no free-zone status affects a study-abroad/visa SARL.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (i) Art. 239 bis AA CGI option to be taxed as a société de personnes (IR) instead of IS — 5-year irrevocable commitment, available to SARLs with exclusively natural-person shareholders exercising a commercial, industrial, artisanal or certain liberal activities; (ii) VAT small-business option: renunciation of the franchise en base de TVA exemption (Art. 293 B CGI) to become a fully taxable person and recover input VAT — generally recommended for B2B services providers; (iii) VAT accounting options: election of the cash-basis régime (TVA sur les encaissements) or the simplified annual régime (régime simplifié d'imposition) instead of the normal monthly régime; (iv) IF group taxation (intégration fiscale, Art. 223 A CGI) once a French parent acquires ≥95% of qualifying subsidiaries; (v) no hybrid-mismatch or check-the-box election exists in France — such configurations must use treaty MFN/EOI routes instead.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), Eurosystem member; foreign-exchange and treasury oversight auxiliary to the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) and prudentially enforced by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for credit institutions and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full euro-area convertibility under Article 63 TFEU and the French Monetary and Financial Code. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted: cross-border service fees, tuition disbursements and management charges may be paid without any exchange-control authorisation, subject only to balance-of-payments (BOP) statistical disclosure to the Banque de France when the transaction exceeds the EUR 12,500 per-operation reporting threshold (bank-captured ISO 20022 purpose codes). Capital-account convertibility allows 100% non-resident ownership and free injection of share capital or shareholder advances; no prior FX approval or conversion requirement applies. Profit-remittance hurdle is purely tax-driven: distributions to a non-resident SARL shareholder incur French withholding taxation at the statutory 25% (treaty-reducible), requiring the distributing company to hold signed board minutes, financial statements, and a French tax residence certificate to evidence treaty eligibility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender, conversion ratio or timeline exists under French or euro-area law for export proceeds. Foreign-currency service and education-related export receipts may be retained indefinitely in multicurrency accounts, with only the Banque de France BOP statistical return applying above the EUR 12,500 threshold. For this study-abroad and immigration advisory (ISIC 7810) business, export proceeds comprise cross-border advisory and placement fees; all are free from surrender obligations and may be invoiced in EUR or foreign currency at arm's length.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / compte de séquestre (blocked funds for share capital deposit)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. (LCL / regional Caisse Régionale)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with linked FX/treasury line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM with material legal constraints. A non-French digital EMI may operate in France only under an EU PSD2/EMD2 passport registered with the ACPR; without this registration it cannot hold client money, open an FR IBAN, or access SEPA/TARGET2 clearing. Escrow and 'séquestre' functions are legally reserved to credit institutions holding a banking licence, so offshore EMIs cannot deliver the capital escrow account required for this SARL. Because ISIC 7810 immigration/visa advisory is internally classified Medium_Risk_Enhanced, French fintechs (notably Qonto, Mango Pay via ACPR passport, and N26 France) will generally accept only the operational account after full RCBE extraction, invoicing evidence, and a physical-interview waiver; they remain an auxiliary treasury rail rather than a substitute for tier-1 bank clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote video KYC is accepted in France since 2021 under ACPR guidance, but tier-1 networks uniformly retain a physical-appearance requirement for the gérant (manager) and the authorised account signatory when the file is SARL-owned, medium-risk-enhanced, or involves non-resident beneficial owners. BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole, BPCE and HSBC France require at least one in-person interview at the commercial branch for the opening signature (signature bancaire); co-signatories may be onboarded remotely via L1-2 cryptographic video identity proof plus a lawyer/notary certified power-of-attorney. For the capital escrow account the physical mandate is strict: the gérant must attend, present the original identity document, and deposit the funds certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-owner opacity above the 25% shareholding/control threshold of the SARL; the bank cannot trace the ultimate natural persons from the INPI register.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE/INPI) extract issued within 3 months; corporate share register; chain-of-ownership chart with constitutional filings; passport and proof-of-address of each natural person identified; notarised and apostilled power-of-attorney for foreign resident shareholders; sworn statement of no undisclosed beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds insufficiency on inbound capital injection; remittance from a non-EEA jurisdiction arrives with no ISO 20022 purpose code or is inconsistent with the equity subscription protocol.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn 'attestation d'origine et de licéité des fonds' executed by each subscribing shareholder; bank reference letter from the remitting credit institution dated within 90 days; last two years of personal or corporate asset and tax documentation; copy of the notarially certified share-subscription resolution; blocked-deposit certificate (certificat de dépôt des fonds) issued by the French receiving bank; reconciliation statement proving the remitter name matches the RBE shareholding registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring escrow-style inflows from foreign student/visa clients (deposit-to-disburse cycles, third-party funders) may be read as layering or 'straw-man' conduct under FATF R.16 equivalences.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed convention de séquestre naming the SARL as escrow holder and the bank as depositary; client-facing fee and refund agreement expressly assigning funds to universities/government visa fees; statutory licence certificate for study-abroad/intermediation (code du tourisme licence) where applicable; SARL AML compliance manual; transactional monitoring rules record; and the most recent audited statement of the company's client-money controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP screening hits from visa-applicant nationalities, counterparty countries, or partners transiting restricted jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative consolidated screening certificate (French ICI/OESC, UN, EU, OFAC, UK lists) generated at the bank feeder; PEP classification memo under Directive (EU) 2015/849; source-of-wealth and travel-history documentation for any flagged applicant; crisply evidence-backed purpose-of-funds file; immediate enhanced-due-diligence narrative submitted to the compliance officer if any residual hit cannot be cleared.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) the foreign shareholder remits contribution via SWIFT MT103 (non-EEA) or SEPA Credit Transfer carrying the beneficiary SARL's IBAN and BIC, with ISO 20022 purpose code 'CAP.INCREASE' (capital increase) or French instruction 'APPORT CAPITAL'; (2) the receiving French bank credits the funds to a blocked funds account (compte bloqué) and issues the statutory 'certificat de dépôt des fonds' attesting availability; (3) the notary proceeds with the capital-increase modification of the SARL articles; (4) funds are released into the operational account upon completion of the legal formality; (5) the Banque de France BOP statistical return for the direct investment is filed through the bank's reporting gateway above the EUR 12,500 threshold; (6) verification is completed by matching the remitter account name to the RBE beneficial-owner register, obtaining the shareholder subscription minutes, and confirming the origin-of-funds statement; the SARL also keeps the deposit certificate as evidence for French tax and anti-money-laundering inspections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement hierarchy: (a) SEPA Instant / SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR payments to university and partner beneficiaries in the EEA; (b) SWIFT MT103 for international wire disbursements denominated in GBP, USD, CHF, JPY and other non-EUR currencies, including tuition fees, visa-application government fees, and counterpart agency commissions; (c) Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700, UCP 600, governed by French law and ICC arbitration) for high-value structured service transactions tied to the golden-visa real-estate or investment conduit; each outgoing transaction is supported by the underlying invoice, student enrolment or immigration agreement, and destination-bank AML vetting for counterparties outside the EEA; documents are retained for the statutory 10-year ACPR/TRACFIN window.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable forward foreign-exchange contract (maturities to 24 months, French Master Agreement/FBF or ISDA terms)
EUR/GBP deliverable forward foreign-exchange contract (maturities to 24 months)
EUR/CHF deliverable forward foreign-exchange contract (maturities to 24 months)
EUR/CNY non-deliverable forward (NDF) permitted under Banque de France exchange-policy recognition for RMB-constrained flows
EUR/INR non-deliverable forward (NDF) permitted under Banque de France exchange-policy recognition for INR-constrained flows
EUR/USD cross-currency swap (ISDA, French law) locked against USD-denominated real-estate or repo obligations of the golden-visa business line

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dépôt des comptes annuels (annual accounts deposit: balance sheet, P&L, annexes, management report and auditor's report, if any)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the INPI Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' Ordinary General Meeting must approve annual accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end (Article L223-26 C. com.); accounts must then be filed within 1 month after approval, i.e. no later than 7 months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 1,500 imposed on the managing director (Article L232-25 C. com.); court may order filing under a daily penalty payment (astreinte); repeated default blocks the RCS file and risks administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Déclaration de résultat n°2065-SD with annexes n°2050 series)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December: due by the second business day following 1 May of the next year (e.g., 5 May 2025 for FY 2024); pro-rated anniversary deadline applies for off-calendar fiscal year-ends
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late interest at 0.20% per month (Article 1727 CGI); late-filing surcharge of 10% if filed within 30 days of the formal notice and 40% for non-filing after a mise en demeure (Article 1728 CGI); managing director exposed to additional penalties for willful omission.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership (UBO) declaration update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through the Guichet Unique (INPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No stand-alone annual due date; must be re-filed within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership (share transfer, control change, amendments to by-laws); annual verification is performed at the Ordinary General Meeting approving the accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalties up to 6 months' imprisonment and EUR 7,500 fine after formal notice (Article L561-46-1 CMF); the RCS company file is blocked for all subsequent statutory filings until the declaration is remedied.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Contribution Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) annual local business property tax assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) collecting for the commune and territorial administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Tax notice issued in autumn; payment due 15 December of each tax year; newly registered companies benefit from a first-year exemption; form n°1447-C-SD due only when rental values or premises change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% plus 0.20% monthly interest (Article 1731 CGI); forced collection procedures (avis à tiers détenteur) after 90 days; statutory minimum CFE (commune-specific, typically EUR 200–EUR 500) applies even in the absence of commercial premises.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT summary declaration (form CA12) – mandatory only under the régime simplifié d'imposition
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) – VAT filing service
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the same date as the corporate income tax return: second business day following 1 May of the next year for the preceding calendar year; monthly or quarterly CA3 returns apply under the régime réel normal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% if remedied within 30 days of formal notice and 40% thereafter, plus 0.20% monthly late interest; incorrect annual VAT positions may trigger reassessment with three-year statute of limitations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when the SARL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at fiscal year-end, tested for two consecutive years: total balance-sheet assets over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT over EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees above 50 (Articles L223-35 and L823-1 C. com.). Appointment is also triggered by a shareholder request representing at least one-third of the share capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – ANC Regulation n°2014-03, as amended); statutory accounts prepared in EUR with balance sheet, profit and loss account and annex; IFRS applies only to consolidated financial statements and remains optional for the standalone SARL statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO filing exists; the beneficial-owner declaration (Article L561-46 Code monétaire et financier) is filed with the RCS at incorporation and must be re-submitted within 30 days of any change of beneficiary, including share transfers modifying control. The managing director must verify the RCS record at each Ordinary General Meeting approving the annual accounts and trigger an update where ownership changed; failure to maintain an accurate record carries criminal fines and freezes subsequent RCS filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members and share transfers (registre des mouvements de titres et des parts sociales)
Shareholders' minutes book (registre de procès-verbaux des décisions des associés)
Register of beneficial owners (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 260–USD 980 per year (approx. EUR 240–EUR 900) for commercial domiciliation or a bundled registered-office service from an accounting firm
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,200–USD 16,000 per engagement (approx. EUR 3,000–EUR 15,000) depending on entity size, number of subsidiaries and internal control environment

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 taxable profit for SMEs; R&D tax credit up to 30% of eligible expenses; innovation status incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration de résultat via impots.gouv.fr (formerly Formulaire 1200-A)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 15 May for calendar year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit before adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only French-source income unless permanent establishment exists; allocate worldwide income proportionally
Claim treaty-based WHT relief with TRC and BOD; substantiate R&D credits with project documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne 3 - Impôt sur les sociétés dû
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% rate to taxable base; attach supporting schedules and TP documentation if applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.75% of tax due per month of delay (capped at 10% or €10,000); under-declaration: 40% penalty on additional tax plus interest; criminal sanctions possible

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Tax Residency Certificate and Beneficial Ownership Declaration via impots.gouv.fr portal; approval within 30 days
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 5% statutory rate reduced by treaties to 0-10%; Interest: 75% statutory reduced by treaties to 0-10%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual turnover for local file; €750 million group consolidated revenue for master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France implements OECD BEPS Action 5 and EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive; requires documented economic substance for preferential regimes; advisory services require minimal substance

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of income or false statements in tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 80% of evaded tax; civil restitution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for criminal sanctions including disqualification and imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining company without genuine business activities or economic purpose for tax benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Company dissolution, fines up to €75,000 and potential criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; directors face personal restitution and possible travel bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform customer due diligence or suspicious transaction reporting in visa advisory services
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover; criminal penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability including imprisonment and professional disqualification
